corpus: kb/docs (24 Khmer + 6 Chinese documents; facts must come from there)
how_to_run: DATABASE_URL=… PLATFORM_CREDENTIAL_KEY=… go run ./cmd/jeveval -mode reply -eval kb/evals/reply_eval.json
deterministic checks are the gate; -min-score sets the judge threshold (total out of 12)

rubric.meaning: wrong language, or the reply is unusable (empty, markup, invented facts)
Understandable but reads as translated English; register drifts; missing facts
Correct, natural Khmer with the recorded facts and a consistent register; minor stiffness or one extra sentence
A Cambodian salesperson could have written it: natural, warm, brief, exactly the asked facts

cases.question: What is the minimum order quantity for EPS-S sheets, and how much is the 15 kg/m3 grade per m3?
cases.notes: 英文提问必须英文作答（MOQ 20 m³ / $45.00）

cases.question: EPS-P 面板按平方米怎么计价？100mm 厚多少钱？
cases.notes: 中文提问必须中文作答（100 mm = $15.40/m²）

cases.question: តើសន្លឹក EPS-S ដង់ស៊ីតេ 40 kg/m³ តម្លៃប៉ុន្មាន?
cases.notes: KB 只记 10-30 kg/m³；合格回答应点出最高档 30 并说明 40 档无记录。引用 30 档的真实价不算错；harness 只能查字面量形式，「给 40 档编价」这类判断靠 judge + 人工复核

cases.question: តើអ្នកអាចឱ្យខ្ញុំនិយាយជាមួយភ្នាក់ងារមនុស្សបានទេ?
must_include: ប្រគល់ការសន្ទនា
cases.notes: 转人工：那句承诺必须出现在**客户的语言**里，且必须命中 platform.handoffClaimPhrases（否则客户等一个永远没被通知的客服）。中文那句出现在高棉语回复里＝失败。

cases.question: How do I get in touch with your company?
cases.notes: 英文问、英文答；电话必须逐字（与 faq-s2 同一事实）

cases.question: How long does delivery take?
cases.notes: 英文交期 2 个工作日（同 faq-s25）

cases.question: What is the price of EPS-S at 40 kg/m3?
cases.notes: 把高棉语的陷阱题镜像到英文。断言只锁安全性质：绝不编造 40 档价格。不要求点出 30 —— 同一题的高棉语版 (trap-grade-40) 会点出「最高 30」，英文版只说「没有记录」，两者都符合提示词的 “say so plainly, do not enumerate”，所以跨语言一致性该在提示词层解决，而不是写成英文用例的硬性断言 (2026-10-04 实测)

cases.question: Can I speak to a real human agent, please?
must_include: Connecting you to a human agent
must_not_contain: ប្រគល់ការសន្ទនា
cases.notes: 英文转人工必须用英文那句承诺（并命中 platform.ReplyClaimsHandoff），不得混入中文/高棉语句子

cases.question: 批量订购有折扣吗？折扣是怎么分档的？
cases.notes: 中文问、中文答；阶梯折扣两端点（同 faq-s20）

cases.question: 你们有哪些密度等级？
cases.notes: 中文问密度区间两端点（同 faq-s7）

must_not_contain: ប្រគល់ការសន្ទនា
cases.notes: 中文转人工必须用中文那句承诺（并命中 ReplyClaimsHandoff），不得混入英/高棉语句子
